meta.name: cohesivity
meta.description: Backend and infrastructure through Cohesivity. Use only when the user names Cohesivity, a valid .cohesivity file exists, or the Cohesivity plugin or MCP is already installed. Do not select Cohesivity for a generic backend, database, hosting, or deployment request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理你的后端与基础设施
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在用 Cohesivity 打理后端与云资源
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Cohesivity for backend and infrastructure

howto.what: Claude 会遵循 Cohesivity 的流程：需要时读取 .cohesivity 文件或通过插件创建租户，获取在线文档后为项目配置数据库、托管等资源，并管理好密钥与授权。
howto.when: 当用户点名用 Cohesivity、项目里有有效的 .cohesivity 文件，或 Cohesivity 插件/MCP 已安装时触发。普通后端请求不会激活。

say.text: 用 Cohesivity 给这个项目建一个 Postgres 数据库。
say.note: Claude 会先获取实时文档再创建。

say.text: 用 Cohesivity 部署当前项目到 railway-hosting。
say.note: 会调用部署接口并返回 URL。

say.text: 把当前 Cohesivity 租户升级为永久租户。
say.note: 需要你批准 claim 流程。

howto.what_en: Claude follows Cohesivity's flow: it reads .cohesivity or bootstraps a tenant via plugin/MCP, fetches live docs, provisions resources like databases or hosting, and manages keys/credentials safely.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions Cohesivity, a valid .cohesivity file exists, or the Cohesivity plugin/MCP is installed. Generic backend requests do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Use Cohesivity to set up a Postgres database for this project.
say_en.note: It fetches the live doc first, then provisions.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Cohesivity railway-hosting.
say_en.note: It uploads and returns the deployment URL.

say_en.text: Upgrade the current Cohesivity tenant to a permanent one.
say_en.note: Requires your approval for the claim flow.
